import pandas as pd,numpy as np,cv2
d=pd.read_csv('/tmp/out1/demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0);o=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png');H,W=img.shape[:2]
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int);vis=img.copy();vis2=img.copy();bad=0;ious=[]
for (i,r),(j,q) in zip(d.iterrows(),o.iterrows()):
  xs=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))));ys=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(','))))
  m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8);cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],1)
  n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m);bad+=n!=2
  assert r.xmin==xs.min() and r.ymax==ys.max()
  cnt+=m;cv2.polylines(vis,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],True,(0,255,0),1)
  qx=np.array(list(map(int,q.coords_x.split(','))));qy=np.array(list(map(int,q.coords_y.split(','))))
  cv2.polylines(vis2,[np.stack([qx,qy],1)],True,(0,0,255) if q.type=='rectangle' else (255,0,0),1)
  if q.type=='polyline':
    m2=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8);cv2.fillPoly(m2,[np.stack([qx,qy],1)],1);ious.append((m&m2).sum()/(m|m2).sum())
print('overlap px',(cnt>1).sum(),'multi-comp',bad,'polyline IoU vs orig',np.mean(ious),np.min(ious))
print('cols same',list(d.columns)==list(o.columns), (d[['type','raw_classification']]==o[['type','raw_classification']]).all().all())
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',np.concatenate([cv2.resize(vis2,None,fx=2,fy=2),cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2)],1))
"
